description.p: This is a community package of FilmCraft, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the FilmCraft project. It repackages the official upstream Linux release build unmodified.

FilmCraft is an open-source, native non-linear video editor written in Rust for people who know Premiere Pro: the same panels, workspaces, tools and shortcuts. Its H.264, HEVC, ProRes and AAC codecs are written in Rust, with no FFmpeg.

ul.li: Three-point editing, every trim tool, markers, nesting and unlimited undo
Frame-exact integer timing, so 23.976, 29.97 drop-frame and 59.94 never drift
Color: basic correction, curves, color wheels, HSL secondary and scopes
Around 90 video effects, transitions and Premiere-style keyframes on a GPU compositor
Audio effects and broadcast loudness meters (EBU R128)
Atomic saves, rolling auto-save and crash recovery

description.p: The headless command runner and MCP server is included: flatpak run --command=filmcraft-cli ai.storyteller.filmcraft --help

Permissions: this package uses upstream's own Flatpak sandbox plus the Videos and Music folders, so project media stored there is found: display (Wayland, with X11 as a fallback), the GPU device, audio playback, and the Pictures, Videos and Music folders. Files anywhere else are opened and saved through the system file chooser. No network access is granted, so speech to text needs the override below.

ul.li: Download the optional Whisper speech-to-text models (off by default), or let agents on the host reach the --control automation server: flatpak override --user --share=network ai.storyteller.filmcraft
Open files by path anywhere in your home folder (command line, Open Recent): flatpak override --user --filesystem=home ai.storyteller.filmcraft
